description: This file defines the ImplementationId class in the org.openmrs package, which models a unique identifier for an OpenMRS implementation, including properties like name, description, implementationId, and passphrase, along with standard methods such as getters, setters, equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: ImplementationId
